articles.summary: Microsoft is currently experiencing an outage affecting its email and cloud services due to server failures. Nearly 130,000 users worldwide have reported connectivity issues with Outlook and Teams.

articles.title: Bearadise Halloween Attraction: Florida DIY haunt grows to 5,000 sq ft; adds Salem witch-trial history
articles.summary: Bearadise in Orange Park has evolved from a simple display into a beloved Halloween destination over the years. Crafted by Matt McCary, this immersive attraction features a graveyard, eerie tombstones, and haunting sound effects.

articles.title: 18th Annual Gala: Toronto event raises over $700,000; gang violence disrupts Haiti students’ schooling
articles.summary: Olivia Wilde's collaboration with Artists for Peace and Justice is pivotal in revolutionizing educational access for Haitian children. Following the devastating earthquake in 2010, the organization launched a free school in Port-au-Prince and now assists over 1,400 students each year.

articles.title: Nostalgic Brisbane Home Purchase: Buyer pays A$4.9m for childhood Queenslander; sale bucks weak auction market
articles.summary: A remarkable Queenslander residence located in Newmarket, Brisbane, was sold for A$4.9 million following an auction. The buyer, who has local roots, had no intention of bidding initially but ultimately decided to secure the property.

articles.title: Can plastic help heal wounds? University of Queensland researchers develop a new biodegradable hydrogel with medical potential
articles.summary: Researchers at Australia's University of Queensland have transformed brittle, biodegradable bioplastic PHB into a water-absorbing hydrogel using gamma radiation and polymer grafting. The new material, called P3HB-HEAA, offers improved mechanical properties and could eventually be explored for wound dressings, tissue engineering, drug delivery and surgical applications.

articles.title: Education Minister launches three digital initiatives of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan
articles.summary: In a step towards realising the objectives of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi on Thursday inaugurated three flagship digital initiatives of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS)..

articles.title: Can students track the secret lives of butterflies and lizards? Georgia Tech is using tiny sensors weighing just 0.03 grams to turn its campus into a living laboratory
articles.summary: Georgia Tech is turning its campus into a living laboratory where students will track lizards, birds and butterflies using miniature wireless sensors. One device weighs just 0.03 grams, making it small enough to attach to a lizard.

articles.title: NSUI stages protest against hazardous air pollution in Delhi, demands immediate action
articles.summary: NSUI held a protest in Delhi against air pollution and called for government intervention to protect public health. Led by Vinod Jakhar, students raised concerns about the severe impacts on residents, particularly vulnerable groups.

articles.title: Mahesh Manjrekar on Nana Patekar’s final hours and Tanushree Dutta controversy: 'He suffered'
articles.summary: Mahesh Manjrekar opened up about the deep sorrow he feels from not being able to visit Nana Patekar before his passing. He lamented how Nana hesitated to seek necessary medical attention despite his worsening condition.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' day 8: Ranbir, Yash, Sai starrer enters Rs 1,000 Cr club
articles.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' has surpassed the Rs 1,000 crore milestone in global earnings. The film reached a total of Rs 1,033.55 crore within its opening week.

articles.title: Shruti Haasan OPENS up about COSMETIC PROCEDURES
articles.summary: Shruti Haasan recently opened up about her thoughts on cosmetic procedures, stressing the importance of being honest about such personal decisions. She believes everyone should feel empowered to express their choices without shame.

articles.title: Dipika praises Ramayana: Chikhlia lauds VFX and star cast
articles.summary: Dipika Chikhlia, who played Sita in Ramanand Sagar’s ‘Ramayan’, says she always knew Ranbir Kapoor and Yash’s ‘Ramayana’ would be a hit. Praising its VFX and star cast, she urged fans to watch it in theatres.
